permutation_assumption: conditional exchangeability of candidate labels under a recorded justified design
query_control: e-BH with full candidate pool, unretrieved e=0

conformal.nonconformity: maximum 1-p over the whole true label set
conformal.not_in_reference: real held-out roots absent from the reference pool
conformal.scorer: development-only fitted positive temperature and not_in_reference intercept; freeze before calibration
conformal.fit_provenance: DataFrame attrs require frozen SHA256 scorer_hash and candidate_universe_hash
conformal.application_provenance: matching scorer_hash and candidate_universe_hash keywords required; otherwise full set, uncalibrated_provenance, no guarantee
conformal.integrity: complete fitted artifact content hash verified before application, including family thresholds and finite/infinite quantiles

upstream_x9: separate immutable source; require its hash when fitting; do not overwrite
null_application_provenance: settings.architecture must match the fitted family architecture signature
